latest_release.name: v0.20.0
latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### Other Changes
* build: read .bun-version by @C4illin in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/673
* build: use bun build to create binary by @C4illin in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/674
* feat: add DjVu conversion support by @al-n in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/612
* feat(auth): prettier login failure page by @JustinShetty in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/665
* feat: use bun archive instead of tar package by @C4illin in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/678
* fix: bugs with marked unit tests by @Laertes87 in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/684
* fix: bump brotli by @C4illin in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/695
* fix: close db on shutdown by @C4illin in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/667
* fix: keep long auto-delete intervals from overflowing setTimeout by @YodHeVauHe in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/672
* fix(ffmpeg): handle embedded cover art in audio conversions by @OrbanGergo in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/607
* fix(ffmpeg): preserve cover art when converting to m4b by @monsterlag in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/679
* test: add djvu converter to main test case by @Laertes87 in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/676
* test: extend and improve unit tests by @Laertes87 in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/663
* test: run tests against docker image by @C4illin in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/664

## New Contributors
* @al-n made their first contribution in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/612
* @monsterlag made their first contribution in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/679
* @YodHeVauHe made their first contribution in https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/pull/672

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX/compare/v0.19.0...v0.20.0
